stories.title: update_issue can add a label without replacing the others
stories.user_story: As someone adopting a hand-made card, I can give it an identity label so a rerun finds it instead of creating a second one.
acceptance_criteria: labels_add sends {"update": {"labels": [{"add": ...}]}}, never a fields.labels PUT
A label with whitespace is rejected before any call
Reachable as a client argument, a tool argument and a CLI flag

tasks.title: client.update_issue labels_add with whitespace check and respx test
tasks.description: Add the argument, the update payload, the validation, and a test that asserts the request body and that existing labels are untouched.

tasks.title: labels_add in the update_issue tool and a CLI flag
tasks.description: Add the field to UpdateIssueArgs, pass it through the handler, add the CLI option, with a dispatch test and a CLI test.

stories.title: create_issue with an identity label is idempotent and read back
stories.user_story: As someone filing a batch of cards, I can rerun the batch and get zero new cards, and a card that does not match what I asked for fails loudly.
acceptance_criteria: 0 hits creates with the label, 1 hit returns the existing card with existing: true, 2 or more is a hard error that creates nothing
After a create or adoption the card is read back by key and summary, parent and label are compared; a difference is a non-zero exit
Issue exposes labels so the read-back can compare them; the default create_issue behaviour is unchanged

tasks.title: Issue.labels and labels in the search fields
tasks.description: Parse labels from the API payload and request them in search_issues so identity lookup and read-back can use them.

tasks.title: identity_label lookup and create in client, tool and CLI
tasks.description: Search labels = X in the project, create/return/error on 0/1/many hits, expose identity_label as a tool argument and --identity-label.

tasks.title: Read-back by key with mismatch errors
tasks.description: GET the issue by key (never a search, JQL lags a few seconds) and compare summary, parent and label; raise on any difference. Fake-client switches make each test fail for exactly one reason.

stories.title: file-cards manifest command, dry-run by default
stories.user_story: As someone filing many follow-up cards, I describe them once in a manifest and the tool creates, adopts and checks them without duplicates.
acceptance_criteria: The whole manifest is validated first, every problem listed at once; a bad or unreadable manifest exits 2 with no Jira call
Dry-run by default, writing needs --apply; --write-keys stores created keys back into the manifest
Never reopens a Done card, status only moves forward through workflow transitions, summary drift is reported not overwritten
One failing item does not stop the others and the exit code is still non-zero; exit codes 0 ok, 1 Jira or read-back failure, 2 manifest or usage error

tasks.title: Manifest model and validator
tasks.description: Pydantic manifest, id pattern, type/parent/status rules, adopt-by-key fields, and a validator that returns every problem.

tasks.title: Plan and apply engine with a fake-client test suite
tasks.description: Per-item decisions (create, adopt, leave, report), forward-only status moves, read-back, per-item failure isolation, and the full list of tests from the spec.

tasks.title: file-cards CLI command and tool registration
tasks.description: Typer command with --apply and --write-keys and exit codes, a call-able tool, and CLI tests.

stories.title: Quick start docs for the plugin in any project, then release
stories.user_story: As a user of the plugin, I can follow a short guide in the README, skills and workflow to start using it in my own project, and get the new behaviour in a released version.
acceptance_criteria: README (both languages) opens with a short install-and-first-command guide for a project, the CLI list and the skills list are current
jira-ticket-ops, symphony-workflow-ops and docs/WORKFLOW.md describe the new commands and the idempotent filing rule
Versions bumped together, CHANGELOG entry, plan INDEX row, implement.md build log; released only through scripts/release.sh after the merge

definition_of_done: Unit tests added for all new or changed code, HTTP mocked with respx.
Each guard removed once makes a test fail (mutation check), then restored.
`uv run ruff check .` and `uv run pytest` pass; `symphony-workflow audit ADLC --open` is clean before and after.
No client or personal names, local paths or credentials in code, docs or docs/runs.
